payload.title: M6: Web IDE — editor, multi-file projects, terminal
payload.description: Intent: As the student, I want a browser IDE with a file tree, tabs, syntax highlighting, a Run button and a terminal pane, so that I can write and run small multi-file projects from anywhere. Includes: Vite/React/Monaco, create/rename/delete files, language selection (Python/C/C++), project persistence, session start on open to hide cold start, terminal pane wired to M3. Excludes: collaborative editing, debugger. DoD: browser-driven Gherkin specs create a two-file C++ project, run it, interact with it, and reload to find it saved.
